outcome: Composite cardiovascular death or worsening heart failure
reason: EMPEROR-Preserved (PMID 34449189, NCT03057951) is restored as the primary result: HR 0.79 (95.03% CI 0.69 to 0.90), 415 of 2997 vs 511 of 2991 patients with a first primary-outcome event, read from the abstract's own primary-outcome sentence. The interval is served at the level it was reported at: the abstract prints '95% CI', but the registered primary analysis (ClinicalTrials.gov results, 'Time to First Event of Adjudicated CV Death or Adjudicated HHF', Cox regression) states 95.03%, alpha-adjusted for the interim analysis; that level is carried as the typed ci_pct with its registry basis, the standard error is derived at it, and the verifier re-derives it from the held registry data. Correction record: on 2026-09-19 this page withdrew a result that had served the CARDIOVASCULAR-DEATH COMPONENT (HR 0.91, 0.76 to 1.09) as the composite, because the outcome declared no components. The composite is now declared from the protocol (O: 'time to first composite cardiovascular death or worsening heart failure, where worsening heart failure includes hospitalization or urgent visit for heart failure as defined by the trial'): cardiovascular death and heart-failure hospitalization are required, the urgent visit counts only where the trial defines it. Endpoint identity now includes the EVENT PROCESS, so the trial's total (first and recurrent) heart-failure hospitalizations, 407 vs 541 EVENTS, HR 0.73, which the stored candidate had attached to this composite as a first-event ratio, is refused (EVENT_PROCESS_MISMATCH), as are the component-only results (CV death HR 0.91; first HHF HR 0.71). Single trial (k = 1), no random-effects pooling. Fix: lane NR V1.0.1 (empagliflozin HFmrEF/HFpEF review 56710eb5).
